chain.rule: Sym^v = sum over l of r^(v-l) H_l; H_l = D^(l,(-1)^l) restricted to the image, pulled back by element_map
Sym^v = sum over l of r^(v-l) H_l; H_l = D^(l,(-1)^l) restricted to the image, pulled back by element_map

Sym^v = sum over l of r^(v-l) H_l; the level is the product of the spin-1/2 irrep of SU(2) and its Galois twin, its matrices in SO(4): a matrix that turns two orthogonal planes by t1 and t2 gives H_l the character chi_(l/2)(t1 + t2) chi_(l/2)(t1 - t2), with t1 + t2 and t1 - t2 equal to w and w' up to sign at a rotation by w (w' = 3w at order 5, else w)

Sym^v = sum over l of r^(v-l) H_l; the level is D^(2,p) restricted, and H_l, the harmonic polynomials of degree l in five variables, restricts to O(3) as the D^(L,p^l) with L = 2k, 2k-2, 2k-3, ..., k for k = l, l-3, l-6, ... >= 0
